name: mitsuketa-zukan-native
description: Native wrapper for わたしの図鑑ライブラリ

scripts.native:prepare: npm run build:native && npx cap sync
scripts.native:ios:add: npm run build:native && npx cap add ios && node scripts/configure-ios.mjs && npm run native:assets:ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.native:ios:open: npm run native:ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.native:android:add: npm run build:native && npx cap add android && npm run native:assets:android && npx cap sync android
scripts.native:android:open: npm run native:android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.native:ios:sync: npm run build:native && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/configure-ios.mjs && npm run native:assets:ios
scripts.native:android:sync: npm run build:native && npx cap sync android && npm run native:assets:android
